notes.title: Chapter 2 and 3 character announcement!
notes.content:
Regarding the release of ChuSingura46+1 S chapter 2 and 3 which will be released at the end of July. We have some main characters that we would like to introduce you all to.

Horibe Yasubee
Voice Actress: Kiritani Hana

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25419201/e2cdcba9ebebac070f74cf9238b89f3ec57c8d55.jpg

Ohishi Chikara
Voice Actress: Hinaki Ai

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25419201/fb88244a9ae057dbcbf59086b3a2f86c89384936.jpg

Also In addition, In Chapter 2 and 3 of ChuSingura46+1 S we would like to introduce various characters that will paint the story.

Please wait a little bit more until we release the DLC.

Regards the CSG crew.
